offers_products.reason: Sells prepared food and beverages: hand-cut steaks, ribs, sides, fresh-baked bread, beer; also some retail gift cards.

offers_services.reason: Operates full-service restaurants with table service and dining experience; restaurants count as service, plus franchise operations.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Diners and families eat at its steakhouse restaurants and order takeout.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are individual diners; no meaningful business or government buyers among main offerings.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat restaurant visits for meals by regular guests; frequent small purchases, though no contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Dining out is discretionary and diners can cut back in a downturn, though value pricing helps.

big_ticket.reason: A restaurant meal is a small, frequent purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay mainly for food and restaurant experience in company-owned locations, not purely staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Customers are households and individual diners.

asset_heavy.reason: Builds and owns many restaurant locations with kitchens and equipment; growth requires ongoing capital for new restaurants.
